marketing_description: The NUVO 65-771R3 ceiling light offers a utility style with a round shape and white finish, making it a versatile option for various settings. This LED fixture features a dimmable 75-watt equivalent bulb with 1473 lumens of output and a color temperature of 3000K, providing a warm and inviting glow. With durable steel construction and a long-lasting average life of 50,000 hours, this fixture is designed to provide reliable performance.
